name: Eggplant
description: Also called aubergine. A glossy-skinned cooking vegetable, from deep purple to the striped variety pictured here.

storage.label: Whole
storage.advice: Plan to use it soon; prolonged cold storage can affect its quality.
storage.caution: Do not leave it forgotten in the crisper for a week.

buying: Choose an intact, firm fruit without bruises.
Look for fresh-looking skin and a sound stem.
freshness: Discard rotten fruit. Surface appearance cannot rule out contamination.

freezing.instructions: Use the linked tested method: peeled ⅓-inch slices are blanched for 4 minutes in boiling water with lemon juice, then cooled, drained, and packed. See the source for the exact water-to-juice ratio.
freezing.quality: Freezing softens the flesh; plan to cook it.
